blocks.text: This page opens the episode of Nihang Gurbakhsh Singh Shahid, introducing him through verse headings and the first lines of his sakhi.
The narrative presents Nihang Gurbakhsh Singh at Amritsar as a blue-clad warrior of disciplined conduct, daily practice, and readiness for martyrdom.
Because the OCR heading is badly damaged, the repaired title and summary preserve the episode boundary while keeping the raw transliteration available for source checking.
